It fits the Large Z Palette perfectly and the MAC Pro Palettes (older slim version.) I wish it were about an inch wider so I could put my Viseart palettes together, but overall I am very happy. reviews.t: By far the BEST palette organizer I have found!
reviews.x: This palette organizer is amazing!  I have been looking for something to compactly contain and organize my eyeshadow palettes for easy access and this is absolutely perfect - much better than the DIY cd racks and letter holders I have seen others using.  However, to get the most storage from this organizer I would recommend using it lying down, not standing up. I waited for months for this to release. So worth the wait! I love that the shelves are removable which allows you to fit more palettes. It looks amazing on top of my Whitmor 5 tier makeup organizer.

This is what I have been waiting for, for palette storage! They are beautiful and make a perfect display. I have mine in the upright position, and was able to fit 9 palettes inside, by stacking together 2 thinner ones. Clearly you can see from the pictures these might not have been made with large over-sized items in mind, when in the upright position. If you lay it flat, you can display larger items like Urban Decay Vice. Its extremely versatile! I love this and will be buying more of them

This is a lot heavier and more sturdy than I expected. It is perfectly sized for the naked palettes. If your palettes are any taller than the naked palettes, I think it's best to lay the organizer horizontally so that the palettes are more stable in the way that I have pictured. Something to note is that the edges are beveled so that the base is a bit wider than the opening. I have this palette organizer laying down and I love how it looks.
Better than expected for the price. Nice sturdy acrylic.

This is my 4th organizer from this company, they make really great quality acrylic organizers!! I bought this smaller palette organizer because I was running out of room in my larger one because of all my smaller palettes taking up space. I love it because fits a ton of different sized palettes. Longer palettes can even fit if stood up on their sides. I'm so in love with this organizer, I'm using it for my makeup palettes. I must admit, its the best I ever owned, I tossed my old ones. I currently have 22 palettes in mine, different sizes. I removed a few divider and it held a lot more than expected. I highly recommend and will definitely be buying it again.  *Honest, No discounted review*

I'm very impressed with how sturdy this palette organizer is. The dividers can slide out if you need them to, but it wasn't necessary for me. The only downside is it isn't long enough for all palettes of mine. That was my own fault and why I didn't deduct. This is ok for me though because I can organize my bindis and other products. The palettes that didn't fit were the Morphe Brushes matte eyeshadow palette and Beau Belle blush palette.

I have it stacked with acrylic organizers from The Container Store, and while it doesn't match exactly, it looks fine (check sizes carefully if you're mixing brands, though!). reviews.t: In love! A lot of my palettes were too wide ...
reviews.x: In love! A lot of my palettes were too wide for the organizer I was kinda bummed at first but I layed it down and they fit just perfectly. Will be buying more in the future once my palette collection extends
Love the organizer! I love that the dividers are removable to customize. Only downfall is that it doesn't stand up very easily like shown it seems like it is very unstable and easy to knock over.

I love this!! For one, prime got me same day shipping in less than 12 hours which was AMAZING! But I was in desperate need of makeup organization and this was a part of my savior package! I was able to put all my regular sized palettes in here. I laid it down instead of having it stand up which worked perfectly! I saw others have it this way in their review photos so it was great! Considering the cost, great quality! I'm not down for spending $200+ for true acrylics when this works perfectly fin

I absolutely love this inexpensive cosmetic storage unit. I have it on my vanity in the bathroom. I now have all my palettes within easy reach and bonus organized. Before I had a stacked up mess of cosmetic palettes. I love that this storage unit is clear and the shelves can slide out easily. I also love that this unit is light weight and not too bulky. I will definitely purchase another if the need arises.
It is so pretty and makes my vanity look great!!! It hold my eyeshadow palettes perfectly and I always get compliments on it!
This Palette organizer comes exactly as described.  Fits perfect in Alexa drawers from IKEA.  Good quality material.

reviews.t: My girlfriend has like the entire Two Face collection
reviews.x: My girlfriend has like the entire Two Face collection. She absolutely loves the organizer as it looks great and is well made. The biggest issue is that the organizer only holds the larger palettes. If it were about 1/2" wider it would hold two of the smaller palettes side by side. Maybe other cosmetics have smaller palettes for us, or maybe it's a way to get you to purchase their smaller palette version. If it's the latter, well they got me as I just ordered one today.

reviews.t: I am using this lying down as recommended by other reviewers in order to hold more palettes
reviews.x: I am using this lying down as recommended by other reviewers in order to hold more palettes. Finally, my makeup is organized! Lying down, it fits: 2 Urban Decay Naked, 2 Too Faced Chocolate Bar, Too Faced PB&J, 2 UD Vice, UD Spectrum, a Lorac one, Tarte Energy Noir, 2 Anastasia, and several blushes on the sides, with a brush case lying on top.

reviews.t: Great for organizing the madicine cabinet
reviews.x: I Love it!! It holds all my face mask jars. The shelves are removable making organizing easy! It's strong and sturdy to use. I highly recommend if you need counter top space but still need to see everything.

reviews.t: Are you the kind of person who forgets to use ...
reviews.x: Are you the kind of person who forgets to use something that you can't see set out? Then this is for you! It helps me be able to see all my makeup palettes at once, so none of them get neglected.
Love this! The trays are removable so you can make each slot bigger if needed for fatter pallets. You can keep your make up organized easy. It's pretty thick too so it should hold up a long time.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the organizer's sturdy, high-quality acrylic construction.
Many customers value the removable dividers, which let them customize the organizer to fit more palettes.
Several reviewers note that some palettes are too wide or tall for the organizer, though laying it horizontally often solves the fit.
Some customers find the organizer unstable or easy to knock over when standing upright.
Reviewers commonly say the product exceeded their expectations for the price.

qa.q: Will my eyeshadow palettes actually fit in this organizer?
qa.answer: It depends on your palette sizes: some reviewers say it fits many different sized palettes and even longer ones on their sides [2], but others found some palettes too wide or too long, including Morphe and Beauty [3][4]. Laying the organizer down helps wider palettes fit [1][4].

claims.text: It fits a ton of different sized palettes, and longer palettes can fit if stood on their sides.
Some palettes were too wide for the organizer, but laying it down made them fit perfectly.
It isn't long enough for all palettes, including the Morphe Brushes matte eyeshadow palette.
Using the organizer lying down rather than standing up is recommended for the most storage.

qa.q: Is the acrylic sturdy enough to last, or does it crack easily?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the acrylic as sturdy and thick, with good weight [1][3][5], and none report cracking. One reviewer notes it is "fairly thick but not thick enough to be 'stable'" in their setup [2], so opinions on sturdiness differ.

claims.text: The acrylic is described as nice and sturdy [1] and of good quality with good weight [5].
One reviewer says the acrylic is fairly thick but not thick enough to be stable in their use [2].
No review reports the acrylic cracking.

qa.q: Can I remove the dividers to fit larger palettes?
qa.answer: Yes, the dividers can be removed to fit larger palettes [1][2][5].

claims.text: The dividers can slide out if needed [1].
Removing a few dividers allowed it to hold a lot more than expected [2].
The clear spacers in the middle are removable for bulkier palettes or more space [5].

qa.q: Does it stay stable when standing upright, or does it tip over?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says it is very unstable and easy to knock over when standing upright [3], and another says palettes hang out making it very unstable [1], while another describes it as strong and sturdy [6].

claims.text: It doesn't stand up very easily and seems very unstable and easy to knock over.
Palettes hang out about 40% making it very unstable.
It is strong and sturdy to use.

qa.q: Is the clear acrylic free of strong plastic smell when new?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
